text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through the Twinkle Series
with my partner Umamusume would begin.
The name of the girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I'm Kiseki!
I'm in your hands, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
It's finally starting...!
A miraculous tale starring me as the protagonist!
You could call this chapter one of the serialization!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Our goal is a masterpiece that will move everyone's hearts—
Let's create the greatest work together!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, our challenge for the Twinkle Series
with <chrname> began!
